assumptions.choice: Use typical price: (High + Low + Close) / 3, weighted by Volume.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires intraday VWAP but does not define the per-bar price basis.

assumptions.choice: Reset VWAP and prior-bar entry history at 09:30; also reset on a date change if a 09:30 bar is unavailable.
assumptions.reason: The feed is regular-session intraday data; the date-change fallback prevents carrying VWAP across sessions.

assumptions.choice: Submit a stop order after the entry order completes and cancel it when a VWAP-cross exit is submitted.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires stop-losses from the actual entry price and only one open position at a time.
